name: a fill is queued past the shared budget
a block already queued is queued again
a worker runs a fill after the mount ended
a worker exits with fills still queued
a fill is queued after the mount ended
an asserted hit leaves the waiting listed fill as it was
replace:
ELSE /\ asserted' = [asserted EXCEPT ![s] = @ \cup {b}]
            /\ UNCHANGED again
       ELSE UNCHANGED <<asserted, again>>

name: an asserted hit behind a running listed fill is not kept
replace:
THEN /\ again' = [again EXCEPT ![s] = @ \cup {b}]
            /\ UNCHANGED asserted
       THEN UNCHANGED <<again, asserted>>

name: the asserted fill that waited is never queued
replace:
THEN /\ queue' = [queue EXCEPT ![s] = Append(@, b)]
            /\ budget' = budget + Size(b)
            /\ asserted' = [asserted EXCEPT ![s] = @ \cup {b}]
            /\ UNCHANGED <<queued, want>>
       THEN /\ queued' = [queued EXCEPT ![s] = @ \ {b}]
            /\ asserted' = [asserted EXCEPT ![s] = @ \ {b}]
            /\ UNCHANGED <<queue, budget, want>>
